note: What a server sends about how its clock and a client's are being brought together. The header carries zero.

fields.name: clientTime
fields.note: The client's clock, in seconds, as the client reported it. A client sets its clock offset from it, taking off half of its own clock's reading less this value.

fields.name: roundTrip
fields.note: The round trip time the server measures, in seconds. A client blends it into a running value, keeping 0.8 of the old and adding 0.1 of this.
